name: whatsapp-personal-render-launcher
description: Render launcher for Discord self bridge (discord-self branch)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix discord-self-mcp install --omit=dev && python3 -m venv discord-self-mcp/.venv && discord-self-mcp/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && discord-self-mcp/.venv/bin/pip install -r discord-self-mcp/requirements.txt
